description: This file contains unit tests for the ResourceModified class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.policies package, focusing on immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception scenarios.

classes.name: ResourceModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ResourceModified class covering immutability, equals/hashCode, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the ResourceModified class and related policy classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the correctness of hashCode and equals methods in ResourceModified using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ResourceModified instance with a null policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ResourceModified instance with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ResourceModified instance with a null label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullResource
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ResourceModified instance with a null resource throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation of the ResourceModified instance.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests the creation of a ResourceModified instance from valid JSON and verifies its fields.
